_readme: Configurator preview photos. The sheet of each configurable product shows a preview that changes with every option; until a photo exists a generated placeholder shows. To add a real photo: (1) save a WebP named by the preview key, 1600 x 1200 or larger, 4:3, as site/img/configurator/<family>/<key>.webp, and a narrower thumbnail of the same shape (about 400 px wide) beside it as <key>-thumb.webp; (2) add a line under "images" below, for example "sink": { "sink-basins-2-under-yes": "site/img/configurator/sink/sink-basins-2-under-yes.webp" }; (3) run: node scripts/build-catalogue.js. The keys are the file names of the owner's shot list (docs/configurator-preview-photo-list.md); the build refuses a key that uses an option value the family does not have, a path other than the one above, a missing file, or a file that is not a readable WebP. When the exact combination has no photo the sheet falls back from the most specific key to the least (for a sink: the exact combination, then without the alignment, then without the upper shelf, then 'sink-basins-N-under-yes'), and finally to the placeholder. Preview photos are never precached by the service worker.
